title: Atmospheric Properties for Future Venus in Each of the 10 Scenarios
transcriptionMethod: Manual transcription from the PDF table, checked against a rendered page and layout-preserving text extraction.
nullSemantics: A null transcribes the table's ellipsis: the property is not listed for that case and must not be interpreted as numeric zero.
assumptions: The grouped column S1-S4, S7, S8 applies identically to all six listed scenarios.
The table values are canonical scenario inputs; any spectra generated from them are derived model products.
notes: S5 and S6 involve ongoing terraforming by removing CO2 and SO2 while beginning to produce O2.
S6 and S9 use starshades to cool Venus.
S10 includes industrial floating cities that release atmospheric pollutants.
Every column descriptor and numeric/null table cell carries an exact table row/column locator.
